title: Abscess with facial swelling, antibiotic and referral

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: My face started swelling yesterday on the left side.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: There's a periapical abscess on nineteen with swelling in the vestibule.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: I'm prescribing amoxicillin five hundred milligrams three times a day for seven days.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: I'm referring you to the endodontist for a root canal on nineteen this week.
